--// Bendecido Silent Aim - Shindo Life 2 (Mobile Optimized & Compact UI Edition)
--// Engine: Janus & Tesavek Optimizations

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local Settings = {
    Enabled = true,
    FOV = 120, -- Reducido por defecto para pantallas móviles
    ShowFOV = true,
    TeamCheck = false,
    Prediction = 0.165,
    TargetPart = "HumanoidRootPart",
    AbilityInfRange = false,
    
    UseWhitelist = false, 
    UseBlacklist = false, 
    Whitelist = {},
    Blacklist = {}
}

local GuiVisible = true

-- Cache de funciones para 0 Lag
local getrawmetatable = getrawmetatable or get_raw_metatable
local hookmetamethod = hookmetamethod or hook_meta_method
local getnamecallmethod = getnamecallmethod or get_namecall_method
local Vector2_new = Vector2.new
local CFrame_new = CFrame.new
local math_floor = math.floor
local WorldToViewportPoint = Camera.WorldToViewportPoint

local CurrentTarget = nil
local IsDragging = false

--// GUI SETUP (COMPACTO PARA CELULAR)
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "Irving_MobileAim_" .. math.random(10000,99999)
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Botón Flotante para Ocultar/Mostrar el Menú Completo en Celular
local FloatingToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
FloatingToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 45)
FloatingToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.15, 0)
FloatingToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
FloatingToggleBtn.Text = "⚙️"
FloatingToggleBtn.TextSize = 20
FloatingToggleBtn.Parent = ScreenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", FloatingToggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 270)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.2, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 22)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Visible = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 38)
Title.Text = "🔥 Irving Mobile Aim"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
Title.TextSize = 12
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = MainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", Title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local StatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20)
StatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 30)
StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusLabel.Text = "Estado: ✅ ACTIVADO"
StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
StatusLabel.TextSize = 10
StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
StatusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
StatusLabel.Parent = MainFrame

local FOVToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
FOVToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 26)
FOVToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 55)
FOVToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70)
FOVToggle.Text = "👁️ FOV Visible: ON"
FOVToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FOVToggle.TextSize = 10
FOVToggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
FOVToggle.Parent = MainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", FOVToggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local TeamToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
TeamToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 26)
TeamToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 87)
TeamToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
TeamToggle.Text = "👥 TeamCheck: OFF"
TeamToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TeamToggle.TextSize = 10
TeamToggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TeamToggle.Parent = MainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", TeamToggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local InfRangeToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
InfRangeToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 26)
InfRangeToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 119)
InfRangeToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
InfRangeToggle.Text = "🌀 Skills Inf Range: OFF"
InfRangeToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
InfRangeToggle.TextSize = 10
InfRangeToggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
InfRangeToggle.Parent = MainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", InfRangeToggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- Botón Maestro de Encendido/Apagado Rápido en UI
local MasterToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
MasterToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 32)
MasterToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 155)
MasterToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 80)
MasterToggle.Text = "⚡ ON / OFF AIMBOT"
MasterToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MasterToggle.TextSize = 11
MasterToggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
MasterToggle.Parent = MainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", MasterToggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local InfoLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
InfoLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 60)
InfoLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 195)
InfoLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
InfoLabel.Text = "💡 Tip: Usa el botón ⚙️ flotante para minimizar la interfaz y evitar estorbos."
InfoLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
InfoLabel.TextSize = 9
InfoLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
InfoLabel.TextWrapped = true
InfoLabel.Parent = MainFrame

-- FOV Circle
local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVCircle.Position = Vector2_new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
FOVCircle.Radius = Settings.FOV
FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FOVCircle.Thickness = 1.2
FOVCircle.Filled = false
FOVCircle.Transparency = 1
FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.ShowFOV

--// TARGET DETECTION
local function GetBestTarget()
    local bestTarget = nil
    local shortestDistance = Settings.FOV
    -- En móviles usamos el centro de la pantalla si no hay puntero de ratón físico
    local screenCenter = Vector2_new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
    
    if not myChar then return nil end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            if Settings.UseWhitelist and not Settings.Whitelist[player.Name] then continue end
            if Settings.UseBlacklist and Settings.Blacklist[player.Name] then continue end
            if Settings.TeamCheck and player.Team and myTeam and player.Team == myTeam then continue end

            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local root = char:FindFirstChild(Settings.TargetPart)

            if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                local screenPos, onScreen = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, root.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local dist = (Vector2_new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
                    if dist < shortestDistance then
                        shortestDistance = dist
                        bestTarget = {
                            Player = player,
                            Root = root,
                            Position = root.Position,
                            Velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity,
                            Distance = dist
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestTarget
end

--// BACKGROUND LOOPS
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        CurrentTarget = Settings.Enabled and GetBestTarget() or nil
        task.wait(0.05)
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if Settings.ShowFOV and GuiVisible then
        FOVCircle.Position = Vector2_new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    end
end)

--// __NAMECALL NETWORK INTERCEPTION HOOK
local oldNamecall
oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
    if not Settings.Enabled or not CurrentTarget then
        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
    end
    
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    local args = {...}

    if Settings.AbilityInfRange and (method == "Raycast" or method == "raycast") then
        local origin = args[1]
        local targetPos = CurrentTarget.Root.Position + (CurrentTarget.Velocity * Settings.Prediction)
        args[2] = (targetPos - origin).Unit * 4.999999721059845e+27
        return oldNamecall(self, unpack(args))
    end

    if method == "FireServer" or method == "fireServer" or method == "InvokeServer" then
        local modified = false
        local predictedLocation = CurrentTarget.Root.Position + (CurrentTarget.Velocity * Settings.Prediction)

        for i, arg in pairs(args) do
            if typeof(arg) == "Vector3" then
                args[i] = predictedLocation
                modified = true
            elseif typeof(arg) == "CFrame" then
                if Settings.AbilityInfRange then
                    args[i] = CFrame_new(predictedLocation)
                else
                    args[i] = CFrame_new(LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position, predictedLocation)
                end
                modified = true
            elseif type(arg) == "table" then
                for k, v in pairs(arg) do
                    if typeof(v) == "Vector3" then
                        arg[k] = predictedLocation
                        modified = true
                    elseif typeof(v) == "CFrame" then
                        if Settings.AbilityInfRange then
                            arg[k] = CFrame_new(predictedLocation)
                        else
                            arg[k] = CFrame_new(LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position, predictedLocation)
                        end
                        modified = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if modified then
            return oldNamecall(self, unpack(args))
        end
    end

    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end)

--// UI INTERACTIONS & TOUCH EVENTS
FloatingToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    GuiVisible = not GuiVisible
    MainFrame.Visible = GuiVisible
    FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.Enabled and Settings.ShowFOV and GuiVisible
    FloatingToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = GuiVisible and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 40)
end)

MasterToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Settings.Enabled = not Settings.Enabled
    StatusLabel.Text = Settings.Enabled and "Estado: ✅ ACTIVADO" or "Estado: ❌ DESACTIVADO"
    StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Settings.Enabled and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
    MasterToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.Enabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
    FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.Enabled and Settings.ShowFOV and GuiVisible
end)

FOVToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Settings.ShowFOV = not Settings.ShowFOV
    FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.ShowFOV and GuiVisible and Settings.Enabled
    FOVToggle.Text = Settings.ShowFOV and "👁️ FOV Visible: ON" or "👁️ FOV Visible: OFF"
    FOVToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.ShowFOV and Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 40, 40)
end)

TeamToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Settings.TeamCheck = not Settings.TeamCheck
    TeamToggle.Text = Settings.TeamCheck and "👥 TeamCheck: ON" or "👥 TeamCheck: OFF"
    TeamToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.TeamCheck and Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
end)

InfRangeToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Settings.AbilityInfRange = not Settings.AbilityInfRange
    InfRangeToggle.Text = Settings.AbilityInfRange and "🌀 Skills Inf Range: ON" or "🌀 Skills Inf Range: OFF"
    InfRangeToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.AbilityInfRange and Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
end)

-- Arrastre Táctil para el MainFrame (Móvil Friendly)
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

local Player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Rooms = workspace:WaitForChild("CurrentRooms")

--// feel free to add your own stuff to the item list just: ClassName#Name (and remember to separate vai "," to separate each item)
local ItemList = "Model#KeyObtain, Model#LiveHintBook, Model#LeverForGate, Model#ChestBox, Model#LiveBreakerPolePickup, Model#FigureRig, Model#Snare"
local CheatingLightColor = Color3.new(0, 255, 0)
local LightDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back

local RbxCreate, tinsert, tclear, tostr = Instance.new, table.insert, table.clear, tostring
local ActiveHints = {}

local function CreateHint(Parent, HintType)
	if HintType == "Hint" then
		local Highlight = RbxCreate("Highlight", Parent)
		Highlight.FillTransparency = 1
		Highlight.OutlineColor = CheatingLightColor
		
		tinsert(ActiveHints, Highlight)
		
	elseif HintType == "Light" then
		local Bulb = RbxCreate("SpotLight", Parent)
		Bulb.Color = CheatingLightColor
		Bulb.Face = LightDirection
		Bulb.Brightness = 5
		
		tinsert(ActiveHints, Bulb)
	end
end

Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CurrentRoom"):Connect(function()
	local RoomID = Player:GetAttribute("CurrentRoom")
	
	for _, hint in ActiveHints do
		if hint and hint.Parent then
			hint:Destroy()
		end
	end
	
	tclear(ActiveHints)
	
	local CurrentRoom = Rooms:FindFirstChild(tostr(RoomID))
	if not CurrentRoom then return end
	
	local Door = CurrentRoom:FindFirstChild("Door")
	if Door then
		CreateHint(Door.Door, "Light")
	end
	
	for _, Object in CurrentRoom:QueryDescendants(ItemList) do
		CreateHint(Object, "Hint")
	end
end)

- Live counters for farm status, enemies alive, allies and total hits

Kill Aura
- Hits the best enemy in range without teleporting you
- Range slider (10-100 studs)
- Its own target pick: lowest HP, closest or frontline first

Summon
- Auto summon, Summon 10 or Summon 1
- Skips the summon animation
- Stops by itself when you pull a 4-star, switch that off to keep going
- Gem reserve (0-5000), it never spends below the number you set
- Summon 10 and Summon 1 buttons
- Teleport to the summon area, open the summon menu, refresh the banner
- Shows your gems, 3-star pity out of 50, 4-star pity out of 400, luck and summon count

Teams and Map Vote
- Auto pick Attackers, Defenders, or whichever side has fewer players
- Join either side with one button, or open the team picker
- Cancel your lobby queue
- Live team count
- Auto vote for the map choice you set (1-4)
- Vote buttons that put you on the pad for each choice

Ranked
- Start or cancel the ranked queue
- Region: Auto, US East, US West, EU Central or Asia East
- Rejoin your ranked match, by hand or automatically
- Create or leave a party
- Shows your rank, RR and queue status

Rounds
- Auto join a round already in progress, or answer that prompt yourself
- Answers the Potato Mode prompt with the choice you set
- Close the match result screen
- Current state and round timer

Defense
- Auto block when an enemy within range (5-50 studs) swings at you
- Block and release buttons
- Anti stun, clears stuns and knockdowns as they land, on by default

Stamina and Movement
- Infinite stamina
- Infinite dodge roll, no cooldown and no stamina cost, Q on PC
- Auto roll while you move
- Roll speed multiplier (1-3)
- Single roll and a 5 roll burst
- Custom WalkSpeed (16-100) and RunSpeed (26-150)
- Auto sprint and sprint speed lock
- Mount or dismount your horse from the menu

ESP
- Name tags on enemy troops, your own troops and workers, each in its own colour
- Clear and reload button

Misc
- Anti AFK, on by default
- Server hop and rejoin
- Mute troop footsteps or all troop sounds
- Ping and FPS readout

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
